title: Deep learning-based structure modeling of the Treponema pallidum proteome: Insights into pathogenesis and syphilis vaccine development.
authors: Houston, Simon; Marshall, Steven; Miller, Austin; Palkowski, Aleksander; Alfaro, Javier A; Cameron, Caroline E
journal: Protein science : a publication of the Protein Society
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold类AI结构建模对梅毒螺旋体全蛋白质组进行结构预测与功能注释，并预测疫苗表位，属于蛋白质结构预测的规模化应用，但方法创新性有限。
abstract: Treponema pallidum ssp. pallidum, the causative agent of syphilis, has a small proteome and encompasses numerous strains. Knowledge gaps remain in understanding the molecular mechanisms of pathogenesis of this bacterium, as well as the structure and function of the full complement of proteins encoded by T. pallidum. Here, an artificial intelligence-based structure-to-function modeling workflow was used to investigate the complement of proteins encoded by T. pallidum. High-confidence structure models were generated for 976 T. pallidum proteins, covering 99% of the proteome. Analysis of the generated models using the protein structure comparison server distance-matrix alignment (DALI) enabled high-confidence, structure-based functional annotation of 877 T. pallidum proteins, including 240 of the 323 proteins of unknown function encoded by this pathogen. Additionally, 63 putative pathogenesis-related proteins (PPRPs) and seven treponemal proteins with previously uncharacterized similarity to outer membrane proteins (OMPs) from Gram-negative bacteria were identified. A workflow for B cell epitope (BCE) prediction identified 1133 surface-exposed, host-facing potential epitopes in known and predicted T. pallidum OMPs, of which 90 were prioritized based on bioinformatic analyses, biophysical properties, amino acid sequence conservation, and previous protein expression data. This work provides insight into T. pallidum pathogenesis through structure modeling-based functional annotation, including characterization of proteins of unknown function. This study also informs syphilis vaccine design by identifying new potential T. pallidum OMPs, as well as host-facing regions of T. pallidum OMPs that have conserved amino acid sequences in globally circulating strains.
abstract_zh: 梅毒螺旋体苍白亚种（Treponema pallidum ssp. pallidum）是梅毒的病原体，其蛋白质组较小，包含众多菌株。在理解该细菌的分子致病机制以及T. pallidum所编码全部蛋白质的结构与功能方面，仍存在知识空白。本研究采用基于人工智能的结构-功能建模工作流程，对T. pallidum所编码的蛋白质组进行了研究。为976种T. pallidum蛋白质生成了高置信度结构模型，覆盖了蛋白质组的99%。利用蛋白质结构比较服务器距离矩阵比对（DALI）对生成的模型进行分析，实现了对877种T. pallidum蛋白质的高置信度、基于结构的功能注释，其中包括该病原体所编码的323种未知功能蛋白质中的240种。此外，还鉴定出63种推定的致病相关蛋白质（PPRPs）和7种与革兰氏阴性菌外膜蛋白（OMPs）具有先前未表征相似性的密螺旋体蛋白质。一种B细胞表位（BCE）预测工作流程在已知和预测的T. pallidum OMPs中识别出1133个表面暴露、面向宿主的潜在表位，其中90个基于生物信息学分析、生物物理特性、氨基酸序列保守性及先前蛋白质表达数据被优先考虑。本研究通过基于结构建模的功能注释，包括对未知功能蛋白质的表征，为T. pallidum的致病机制提供了见解。同时，通过识别新的潜在T. pallidum OMPs以及在全球流行菌株中具有保守氨基酸序列的T. pallidum OMPs宿主面向区域，为梅毒疫苗设计提供了信息。
